project: DNAzyme-based sensors / DNA-based nucleic-acid sensing records

steps.description: Load PDF and web extracted CSVs, map heterogeneous source columns into the project dataset schema, and write data/interim/merged_records.csv.
Map empty strings, NA, N/A, none, null, -, and nan-like tokens to empty CSV cells.
Convert concentration units pM, nM, µM/uM/μM, and M to normalized_value_nM. Non-concentration units such as fold, ng/uL, ng/µL, ng, CFU, cells, and min^-1 are preserved but not converted.
Uppercase sequence-containing strings while preserving component labels, semicolons, fluorophore/quencher annotations, and linker names.
Coerce numeric columns such as measurement_value, lod_nM, temperature_c, pH, Mg_mM, and Na_mM to numbers when possible.

Drop duplicate record_id values first. Then drop exact duplicate measurement rows by source_id, sensor_architecture, dnazyme_name, target_name, measurement_type, measurement_value, measurement_unit, and source_location.
Write schema-aligned final dataset to data/processed/dataset.csv.
Write an additional LOD-only subset to data/processed/dataset_lod_only.csv using records where measurement_type equals LOD.
Run scripts/validate_project.py after cleaning to check required files, schema alignment, record_id uniqueness, numeric measurement values, and source_id warnings.

normalization_rules.sequence_rule: Uppercase; collapse whitespace; preserve component labels and modification annotations such as FAM, BHQ, HEG, rG/rU, and component_name=sequence.
